entry.title: MillBill: A Machining Agent with Geometric Feedback
entry.summary: Turning a CAD model into a machining program requires both process knowledge and geometric precision. Language models can generate such workflows by writing geometry and toolpath code for each part, but this makes numerical execution part of the model's task. entry.title: CADMAGEDDON: High-Fidelity CAD Reconstruction with Local Inference
entry.summary: CAD practitioners often work with proprietary parts that they are unwilling to share with external services. For individuals and small companies, bringing this work in-house also requires computational resources they can afford.
